notes.title: About Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
We have updated the game to address bugs and issues


 Fixed a movement bug during view rotation in FPS mode.
 Fixed a bug where the shop UI in Terra Absorpta appeared smaller on certain monitors.

notes.title: Updated Prototype of 3D Dungeon RPG ver 1.0.5
notes.content: Added title screen, base, shop, save function, and more to the 3D Dungeon RPG game "Terra Absorpta."

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
BoxMover
Fixed an issue where the "Restart" button could not be pressed after completing the game.
Fixed stage names to display properly even if they are long.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
BoxMover
Save progress up to the last completed stage
Fixed to display the total number of stages

notes.title: About Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Updated game content regarding bugs and glitches

 Fixed a bug in BoxMover regarding the behavior of boxes
 Added the ability to exit the game from the menu screen
 Fixed multiple input bug with DPad

notes.title: About Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
We have made updates to address bugs and issues in the game.

Fixed a bug related to box behavior in BoxMover.
Added the option to quit the game from the menu screen.
Resolved a multi-input bug with the D-Pad.
